notes.title: Lift Attendant 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Features:
- Added a new game mode, Scenario! In Scenario mode, you are provided a set of pre upgraded elevators to use and upgrades are no longer available. Without the worries of having to upgrade, you can focus purely on transporting passengers
- Added Leaderboards for Scenario Mode
- Added initial elevator details in level introduction window
- Display Best and Average global leaderboard times in-game
- Added new Steam Achievement for completing all Scenario levels

Improvements/Enhancements:
- Changed displayed time to seconds to be consistent with leaderboards

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug with ESC hotkey not working in Main Menu Leaderboard view
- Fixed bug with some sounds not respecting the volume settings

notes.title: Lift Attendant v1.0.8 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Added a restart level button on the game menu
- Reduced difficulty for some levels by increasing time limit

notes.title: Leaderboards are here!
notes.content:
Lift Attendant was officially released on July 31st, 2024. While the game is mostly complete, there are still a few updates I'm planning for the short term. I'm happy to announce that the first major update is now live!

Efficiently transporting passengers is the name of the game in Lift Attendant, and now you can see how you stack up against other players with the new Leaderboards feature! Access the leaderboards on the same screen where you select levels. The current leaderboards are based on total time completion for each level. There is definitely a possibility for additional leaderboards in the future, such as highest earned money per level, and also if there are additional game modes added, which is a major feature planned for the near future.

Lift Attendant is still available with an introductory offer of 10% discount until August 7th.
